_NOTE: PREVIEW ONLY -- not yet renderable via main.py. melodic_arc is wired into melody.py's generate_lyrical and generate_melody_for_progression (Phase 2 of the apex/goal-tone build), but Phase 6 (SectionModel schema field + generator.py passthrough) hasn't happened yet, so main.py doesn't know how to read this field out of a piece JSON yet. The accompanying piece_apex_cadence.mid was rendered by calling generate_melody_for_progression directly, the same way every other engine-level sanity check in this project has been produced -- this JSON shows the shape Phase 6 will accept once that wiring lands, not something you can hand to main.py today.

verse._melodic_arc_note: resolve_every_cycle=false (Choice A): this progression repeats 4 times to fill the section, but cadence pull only fires once -- on the true final chord of the whole section. The other 3 loop-backs keep their groove uninterrupted, the way a verse or vamp should.

chorus._melodic_arc_note: resolve_every_cycle=true (Choice B): this progression repeats 4 times too, but cadence pull fires at the end of EVERY repeat, not just the section's end -- each pass through the hook gets its own small resolution, the way a satisfying chorus should.
